name: Ranawat Burj at Hill Fort Kesroli
why_it_matters: Restaurant of Neemrana's Hill Fort Kesroli, a 14th-century fort in Alwar district converted by the Neemrana group into one of India's earliest heritage hotels. North-Indian core menu with Continental, Italian and Oriental supplements; chef Ram Lal personally takes orders.
insider_tip: The 5-6 pm tea ritual is included for residents but non-residents can book it as a walk-in if the property isn't at full house — call ahead.
signature_address: Neemrana's Hill Fort Kesroli, Village Kesroli, near M.I.A. Post Office Bahala, Alwar District, Rajasthan 301030

name: Prem Pavitra Bhojnalaya
why_it_matters: Pure-veg North-Indian bhojnalaya operating since 1957 near Old Bus Stand — the Alwar restaurant locals point to first when asked about thalis. Ranked #4 of 94 Alwar restaurants on TripAdvisor; no alcohol.
insider_tip: The phulka is rolled in ghee on the tawa itself — that's the trick they're known for. Ask for a fresh-off-the-pan one with the dal fry.
signature_address: Near Old Bus Stand Road, Kabir Colony, Alwar, Rajasthan 301001
